fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (NASDAQ: WMT) net income increased 63% over five years from $13.7B in 2021 to $22.3B in 2026; however, current P/E of 46.5x appears excessive compared to S&P 500 (23.3x) and AI stocks (significantly lower multiples).
fields.summary_ko.1: 2026–2029 projected EPS CAGR of 11.1% is difficult to justify current valuation, and downside risk exists as P/E multiple compression over the next 5–10 years is more likely.
